---
title: "Lab Regression Crab"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
crabs <- read.csv("../dioxin2.csv")
head(crabs)
View(crabs)
```

```{r}
summary(crabs)
```

```{r}
crabs$Site <- as.factor(crabs$Site)
summary(crabs)
```

```{r}
plot(TEQ ~ Year, data = crabs)
```

```{r}
fit.tmp <- lm(TEQ ~ Year, data = crabs)
plot(fit.tmp)
```

```{r}
MASS::boxcox(TEQ~Year,data=crabs)

# library(MASS)
# boxcox(TEQ ~ Year, data = crabs)
```

```{r}
crabs$logTEQ <- log(crabs$TEQ)
plot(logTEQ ~ Year, data = crabs)

```

```{r}
fit <- lm(logTEQ ~ Year, data = crabs)
summary(fit)

fit2 <-lm(logTEQ ~ Year + Site, data = crabs)
summary(fit2)
```

```{r}
anova(fit, fit2)
```

```{r}
# linear regression with year and site as predictors
fit3<-lm(logTEQ ~ Year + Site + Year*Site, 
         data = crabs)
summary(fit3)

```
```{r}
anova(fit2, fit3)
```
